HADESANCIENTS-BRILLIANT_RIPOSTE.title: Brilliant Riposte
HADESANCIENTS-BRILLIANT_RIPOSTE.descript: Fully blocked attack damage is reflected to your attacker.
HADESANCIENTS-BRONZE_SKIN.title: Bronze Skin
HADESANCIENTS-BRONZE_SKIN.description: You take [blue]{LessDamagePercent}%[/blue] less damage from enemy attacks.
HADESANCIENTS-BRONZE_SKIN.flavor: "You fight as though you're unencumbered, but I know the surface weighs on you."
HADESANCIENTS-DEFENSIVE_POSTURE.title: Defensive Posture
HADESANCIENTS-DEFENSIVE_POSTURE.descript: The first time you are hit by an enemy each combat, prevent that damage and become immune to enemy damage until the start of your next turn.
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_DASH.title: Divine Dash
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_DASH.description: Start each combat with [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills, gain [blue]{BlurPower}[/blue] [gold]Blur[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_INTERVENTION.title: Divine Intervention
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_INTERVENTION.descri: At the end of your [blue]{DamageTurn}th[/blue] turn, instantly win the combat. In Boss combats, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies instead.
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_INTERVENTION.flavor: "For we do not fail; merely take the necessary time to succeed."
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_PROTECTION.title: Divine Protection
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_PROTECTION.flavor: "You bear the Amulet I gave to you. May it protect you and strike fear into the hearts of your enemies, whenever I am not around to do the same."
HADESANCIENTS-MENTAL_BLOCK.title: Mental Block
HADESANCIENTS-MENTAL_BLOCK.description: Start each combat with [blue]{ArtifactPower}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. Whenever your [gold]Artifact[/gold] triggers, gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-PHALANX_SHOT.title: Phalanx Shot
HADESANCIENTS-PHALANX_SHOT.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-PROUD_BEARING.title: Proud Bearing
HADESANCIENTS-PROUD_BEARING.flavor: "Be proud, Cousin! You have achieved a glorious result, for which we all are thankful."
HADESANCIENTS-RENEWED_FAITH.title: Renewed Faith
HADESANCIENTS-RENEWED_FAITH.description: At the start of your turn, if you have [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] HP or less, heal to full HP and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Works once.
HADESANCIENTS-RENEWED_FAITH.flavor: "Now let's get you back to proper fighting shape."
HADESANCIENTS-RIGHTEOUS_PIKE.title: Righteous Pike
HADESANCIENTS-RIGHTEOUS_PIKE.description: Every {Energy:energyIcons()} you spend, deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] times.
HADESANCIENTS-RIGHTEOUS_PIKE.flavor: "And I wouldn't advise getting run through by my spear, yet at times it must be done."
HADESANCIENTS-STALWART_STAND.title: Stalwart Stand
HADESANCIENTS-STALWART_STAND.description: Upon pickup and at the start of each future Act, gain [blue]{DeathDefianceToGain}[/blue] [gold]Death Defiance[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-STALWART_STAND.flavor: "Thank the Fates that you eluded Typhon's fury."
